site.about.finalText: We'd like to hear what your team needs.
site.about.lead: PulseBoard is a project management app for teams who want to see the real state of their work — including the state of PulseBoard itself.
site.about.statusText: PulseBoard is in active development and isn't production-ready yet. Some features are previews; the pricing page lists each one's real status.
site.about.v1Text: Every workspace is isolated by database rules, not just by hiding buttons.
site.about.v2Text: Features say whether they're in the app, a preview or planned — no inflated lists.
site.about.v3Text: Suggestions are suggestions: nothing important changes without a person deciding.
site.about.v4Text: Full English and Urdu, with dates and numbers in your language.
site.about.why1: Most boards show tasks; few show whether a project is healthy. PulseBoard turns overdue, blocked and buggy work into one live score with its reasons, so a team notices trouble early.
site.about.why2: It is built for teams of any size, works in English and Urdu with a full right-to-left layout, and keeps every workspace's data separate at the database level.
site.contact.helpText: The features and pricing pages list what's built today and what's coming.
site.contact.lead: Questions about plans, security, a feature you need, or working together.
site.contact.messagePlaceholder: Tell us what you need (at least 20 characters)
site.contact.notSetUp: Contact isn't set up on this site yet, so messages can't be sent from here.
site.contact.opened: Your email app should open with the message filled in. Send it from there.
site.contact.privacy: This form doesn't store anything: it opens your own email app with the message ready to send.
site.contact.securityText: Choose the Security topic and describe what you found. Please don't include passwords or other people's data.
site.f.analytics.lead: Delivery numbers from your own task data, not guesses.
site.f.analytics.p1: Live project health score with its reasons
site.f.analytics.p2: Burn-up, cumulative flow and weekly throughput
site.f.analytics.p3: Cycle time, lead time and SLA targets per priority
site.f.analytics.p5: Team wellbeing signal (a limited signal, never an HR score)
site.f.analytics.title: Analytics
site.f.assistant.lead: Helpers that read your board and suggest — you always decide. Rule-based by default.
site.f.assistant.p1: Turn a sentence or meeting notes into tasks
site.f.assistant.p3: Smart assign: who should take this task, and why
site.f.assistant.p5: Optional Google Gemini, switched on by an Admin
site.f.assistant.title: Assistant
site.f.automation.lead: Let routine steps happen on their own when a task changes.
site.f.automation.p1: When / then rules (e.g. when a task becomes high priority, notify me)
site.f.automation.p2: Describe a rule in a sentence and it's built for you (rule-based)
site.f.automation.p3: Recurring tasks that create the next one when done
site.f.automation.title: Automation
site.f.boards.lead: Boards with your own columns and WIP limits, and tasks with everything a task needs.
site.f.boards.p1: Custom boards and columns, with work-in-progress limits
site.f.boards.p2: Subtasks, checklists, labels, due dates and priorities
site.f.boards.p4: Bulk actions, CSV import / export and task templates
site.f.boards.p5: Archive, trash and undo for deleted tasks
site.f.boards.title: Boards & tasks
site.f.clients.lead: Keep client work, budgets and approvals next to the tasks.
site.f.clients.p1: Clients with hourly rates, budgets and report days
site.f.clients.p3: Read-only share links for a task or board
site.f.clients.p4: Embeddable roadmap and public request form
site.f.clients.title: Clients & sharing
site.f.focus.lead: Track time where the work is, and protect time to do it.
site.f.focus.p3: Focus mode and Do Not Disturb
site.f.focus.title: Time & focus
site.f.team.lead: Roles that decide who sees which pages and who can change what — enforced by the database.
site.f.team.p1: Roles for every teammate, checked on the server
site.f.team.p3: Pre-approved email invites (no invite email is sent yet)
site.f.team.p5: Two-factor sign-in with an authenticator app
site.f.team.title: Team & permissions
site.f.views.lead: See the same tasks the way that fits the moment.
site.f.views.title: Views
site.features.lead: Each point is labelled: In the app (built and usable today), Preview (demo, simulated, or waiting on setup) or Planned.
site.features.statusNote: Labels follow the same rules as the pricing page and are updated as features ship.
site.features.titleB: — and how ready each part is.
site.footer.status: In active development: every feature on this site shows whether it's in the app, a preview, or planned.
site.footer.tagline: Boards, views, roles, automation and analytics for teams — in English and Urdu.
site.home.featuresLead: Core features — open any of them to see exactly what's built today.
site.home.featuresTitle: Everything a team needs to run its work
site.home.finalText: The Basic plan is free. Upgrade only if your team needs more.
site.home.finalTitle: Try it on a real project
site.home.honestText: PulseBoard is in active development. Instead of a long list of promises, every feature carries one of three labels.
site.home.lead: PulseBoard gives every board a live health score, so overdue, blocked and buggy work shows up before it becomes a problem.
site.home.step1Text: Sign up with your email and name your workspace. You're its Admin.
site.home.step2Text: Start from a template or a blank board, then add tasks, subtasks and due dates.
site.home.step3Text: Pre-approve teammates by email with a role, and watch the health score as work moves.
site.home.titleB: with your project's pulse in view.
